title: Olea feasibility experiment — final evidence report
expectedMission: Kotlin Android host supervises minimal Ubuntu Base/PRoot, one shared stock Node backend and persistent unmodified Pi RPC subprocesses. Required evidence includes real Unix/dependency/child work, three Pi releases, ordinary upgrade, permission-controlled Accessibility launcher click and all phone categories, independently asserted model workflows, lifecycle recovery and measured total resource cost.
actualMission: Disposable Android target28 host now runs verified Ubuntu24.04.3/PRoot5.1.107.102 and upstream Node24.20.0 under its real app UID10216 through Kotlin supervision. Independent Unix shell, Git commit/git-show, DNS/TLS, npm dependency and child assertions pass. Shared backend JSONL ready/status roundtrip and direct native Accessibility launcher click/foreground plus stop/auth checks pass. Android stock Pi0.74.0 now completes independently verified model Unix work, persistent RPC, resume, two concurrent prompts and cancel; its backend-shutdown descendant check failed separately. Baseline1.5.2 now independently passes actual model tool discovery, Accessibility launcher ACTION_CLICK and combined Unix/private-fixture assertion after successful same-prefix ordinary updates. Standalone1.0/1.5 Unix/concurrent file cases fail independently and are retained; later shutdown checks pass but do not erase original0.74 leak. Direct/native and model evidence remain separate; full category/resource/constrained/physical validation still incomplete.
rationale: Actual Android-hosted stock Unix/model work, ordinary upstream updates and independently verified agent Accessibility-plus-Unix workflow establish promising feasibility. Do not accept the candidate unchanged: tested modern-target writable execution fails; deterministic descendant leakage was measured then a generic backend repair independently passed a targeted no-model case; later model Unix/concurrent file assertions fail; full phone coverage, total resource/lifecycle/constrained and physical-device evidence remain incomplete. Revisions and targeted validation are required, not a blanket runtime rejection.
